name: Digitraffic Rail (Finnish train locations)
short: Live GPS positions and speeds of trains in Finland; free, keyless GeoJSON.
summary: Fintraffic's Digitraffic service publishes the latest location of each running train in Finland as GeoJSON: train number, departure date, speed, GPS accuracy and timestamp. No key is needed; the server requires gzip.

tasks: live position and speed of a train in Finland
latest location of one train number

pricing.notes: Terms of service page: open data under CC 4.0 BY. No fee or key is mentioned.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: latest locations returned 130 trains with timestamps within seconds of the request.

delivery.basis: Live check 2026-11-08: latest locations returned 130 trains with timestamps within seconds of the request.

coverage.notes: Trains currently reporting a GPS location; trains without a position are absent.

licensing.summary: Digitraffic terms: Fintraffic's open data is licensed under Creative Commons 4.0 BY, which allows distributing, remixing and commercial use with credit to the source; the notice and a link to the licence must be kept and changes indicated. AI training and resale are not mentioned.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: Latest location of every running train as GeoJSON; properties trainNumber, departureDate, speed, accuracy, timestamp.

api.notes: Requests need an Accept-Encoding: gzip header; without it the server answers 406.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each position has a timestamp supplied by the train's reporting system; how it is set is not stated.

location.unknown: Positions are GPS fixes with an accuracy value; nothing independent is described.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.

sources.claim: Digitraffic terms of service: CC 4.0 BY licence and attribution rules
